name: codeql-externally-controlled-format-string
hook: console.error with job.id interpolation triggers CodeQL alert
body:
CodeQL rule `js/printf-args` (Use of externally-controlled format string) triggers when a value from an external source is interpolated into a string passed to console methods. The fix is to pass the external value as a separate argument: `console.error('msg:', externalValue)` instead of `console.error(`msg ${externalValue}`)`.

**Why:** job.id comes from Payload's job queue; job.input can contain user-controlled data. CodeQL treats the whole job object as externally-controlled, so even job.id triggers the alert when interpolated.

**How to apply:** When CodeQL flags a console.* call with an interpolated value from a queue/job/external source, pass that value as a separate argument instead.
